AddressOfSite: Name, street, house number, building number
DescriptionOfMainBusinessRelationships: e.g. key suppliers, customers distribution channels and consumers
DescriptionOfSustainabilityRelatedCertif: This disclosure should include, where relevant, the issuers of the certification or label, date and rating score
EmployeeTurnoverRate: Calculation: (number of employees who left during the reporting period / average number of employees during the reporting period) * 100
FemaleToMaleRatioAtManagementLevelForThe: Calculation: number of female employees at management level / number of male employees at management level
FinancialInvestmentInTheCapitalOrAssetsO: Referred to in the Council Recommendation of 29 September 2023 (excluding donations and contributions)
GenderDiversityRatioInGovernanceBody: Calculation: number of female board members / number of male board members
PercentageGapInPayBetweenFemaleAndMaleEm: Calculation: ((average gross hourly pay level of male employees - average gross hourly pay level of female employees) / average gross hourly pay level of male employeees) * 100
PercentageOfEmployeesCoveredByCollective: Calculation: (number of employees covered by collective bargaining agreements / total number of employees) * 100
RateOfRecordableWorkRelatedAccidentsInTh: Calculation: (number of recordable work-related accidents in the reporting year / total number of hours worked in a year by all employees) * 200000. The amount of 200000 hours represents the total annual working hours of 100 employees (40 hours per week for 50 weeks per year) and serves as the standard base for calculating the incidence rate over a year, applicable to undertakings with up to 250 employees
Scope1AndScope2GreenhouseGasEmissionsInt: Calculation: (Scope 1 + Scope 2 GHG emissions location-based) / turnover
Calculation: (Scope 1 + Scope 2 GHG emissions market-based) / turnover
TotalGrossLocationBasedGHGEmissions: Calculation: Scope 1 + Scope 2 + Scope 3 GHG emissions (location-based)
TotalGrossMarketBasedGHGEmissions: Calculation: Scope 1 + Scope 2 + Scope 3 GHG emissions (market-based)
TotalLocationBasedGreenhouseGasEmissions: Calculation: (Scope 1 + Scope 2 + Scope 3 GHG emissions location-based) / turnover
TotalMarketBasedGreenhouseGasEmissionsIn: Calculation: (Scope 1 + Scope 2 + Scope 3 GHG emissions market-based) / turnover
TotalWasteGeneratedMass: Calculation: total Hazardous waste generated + total Non-Hazardous waste generated (mass)
TotalWasteGeneratedVolume: total Hazardous waste generated + total Non-Hazardous waste generated (volume)
TotalWasteRecycledReusedAndDirectedToDis: Calculation: waste diverted to recycle or reuse + waste diverted to disposal (mass)
Calculation: waste diverted to recycle or reuse + waste diverted to disposal (volume)
